sections.heading: Intro
sections.content_markdown:
Recovery is a system, not a byproduct. These five variables are the physiological infrastructure that makes adaptation possible.
| Variable | Mechanism | Target |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Sleep | Endocrine + recovery regulation | ≥7h continuous, same schedule daily |
| Sauna | Circulation + parasympathetic recovery | 3–4x/week, 20 min + 2 min cold |
| Hydration | Performance + thermoregulation | ≥4L/day + 2–3g Na |
| Nutrition | Recomposition energy demand | Per active goal (Layer 4) · protein 2g/kg LBM |
| Stress | Readiness stability | Breathwork · mobility · low-intensity Zone 2 |

sections.heading: Decision Rules
sections.content_markdown:
Sleep <6h → train at MEV only (overrides Plan)
Sauna replaces hydration losses → +500ml + electrolytes post-session
Protein floor: 2g/kg LBM regardless of goal kcal
Stress markers (HRV ↓, sleep ↓) trigger autoregulation per Layer 3
